verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm's website; evidence mentions AI/ML-based Legaltech used internally for contract review efficiency, but there is no evidence of an actual product delivering AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's own data inside a product interface. No dashboard, tool, or user-facing analytics capability is documented. Missing for 10: any user-facing product with data upload/analysis, AI-generated insight generation, or suggestion features accessible to an end user.
